modern: In conversation you must pay attention to what is said, and in every movement you must observe what is being done. And in the one you should see immediately what end it refers to, but in the other watch carefully what the thing signified is.
original: In discourse thou must attend to what is said, and in every movement thou must observe what is doing. And in the one thou shouldst see immediately to what end it refers, but in the other watch carefully what is the thing signified.
